name: sol_integrations_chainlink_vrf_1
description: Unverified parameters passed to Chainlink VRF requestRandomWords call
question: The source file in `source` calls Chainlink VRF's requestRandomWords (or a wrapper around it) passing parameters such as keyHash, subscriptionId, requestConfirmations, callbackGasLimit, or numWords that are taken directly from constructor/user/external input or hardcoded without validating them against expected values or safe bounds, so a malformed or attacker-influenced parameter can cause fulfillRandomWords to silently return an incorrect random value or fail to revert on invalid input, excluding cases where every VRF parameter is validated against known-good constants or subscription ownership before the call, or where parameters are fixed immutable values set and checked at deployment by a trusted admin.
criteria: requestRandomWords is called with a subscriptionId variable that is never checked to match the contract's actual funded subscription before submitting the request
numWords is passed directly from a user-controlled or external input into requestRandomWords without any minimum/maximum bounds check
keyHash is taken from a constructor or setter argument and used in requestRandomWords without verifying it matches the network's known valid keyHash
callbackGasLimit is set from an unchecked variable and passed to requestRandomWords without enforcing a minimum value needed for fulfillRandomWords to execute correctly
requestConfirmations is hardcoded to an insufficiently low value or taken from unchecked input without validating it against the chain's safe minimum confirmation count
